cases.rule: Client must never control trusted identity
No RAG filter on provisional product request
Do not invent confidence calibration fields
No answer is not technical failure
Technical error must not claim success
Unresolved citation must not present synthetic locator as evidence
Unresolved source must not invent author
Synthetic fixture cannot claim source verification
Provisional cannot carry real release id
Synthetic data may not claim live producer
Delete success requires confirmed backend and completed at
Delete command must have explicit user confirmation
Delete does not depend on optional Export contract
Pagination more needs opaque next cursor
Page must contain only authenticated owner
Client display cancel != confirmed server cancellation
Internal RAG phase must be backend-reported
Terminal session must have one end event
UI display stop != actual backend stop
Idempotency conflict requires error and no message ID
Snapshot link must match persisted answer ID
Every citation reverse reference must resolve
Citation and claim reverse links must agree
Partial output must retain visible partial content
Unknown outcome cannot be successful completed result
Receipt must include server-bound user identity
